picks.editorial_note: A decades-long research program at Penn has produced an implantable neurostimulation system that predicts and treats memory loss — a rare case of AI-driven basic science translating directly into a deployable medical device.
picks.title: A ‘breakthrough’ to restore memory | Penn Today

picks.editorial_note: DOE tapped a Fermilab-led team for its Genesis Mission to build AI systems that control particle accelerators, signaling a significant federal bet on AI for large-scale physics infrastructure.
picks.title: DOE selects Fermilab-led AI initiative to advance particle accelerator performance

picks.editorial_note: A Google-led, UK government-backed £5M trial will use AI to adjust flight paths and cut contrail-driven climate warming — a rare instance of AI research moving straight into real-world aviation policy and industry practice.
picks.title: World’s first trial to test if flightpath changes could cut aviation’s climate impact

picks.editorial_note: Johns Hopkins and Toyota Research Institute are combining AI with high-throughput automated experiments to speed discovery of new battery materials, pairing academic AI expertise with industrial R&D muscle on a problem central to the energy transition.
picks.title: Johns Hopkins team partners with Toyota Research Institute to accelerate new battery discovery

picks.editorial_note: An AI-powered digital twin built with NASA funding got an unplanned real-world stress test during actual Norfolk flooding, offering rare validated evidence that AI coastal-defense tools work outside the lab.
picks.title: When Norfolk Flooded, ODU Coastal Defense Research Faced an Unexpected Real-World Test

picks.editorial_note: A $9M NSF-funded browser-based platform unifying access to national HPC centers directly supports the NAIRR effort to democratize AI compute for researchers nationwide.
picks.title: NCSA Partners with UCLA for iDLab

picks.editorial_note: A five-year Imperial–Smith+Nephew partnership aims to translate academic computer-vision research directly into surgical robotics products, a concrete pipeline from AI research to clinical practice.
picks.title: New centre from Imperial and Smith+Nephew will accelerate innovation in surgical robotics

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL's discovery of 'attribution decay' — that generative AI outputs from large datasets often can't be traced to specific training examples — has direct implications for the ongoing legal and policy debate over AI training data and copyright.
picks.title: When AI art has no author: MIT study finds generated images often can't be traced to any training data

picks.editorial_note: FRONTEO and Science Tokyo's new research cluster pairs an established AI drug-discovery platform with academic biomedical expertise, a notable industry-academia bet on accelerating pharmaceutical R&D.
picks.title: FRONTEO and Science Tokyo establish industry-academia Collaborative Research Cluster for AI-driven drug discovery | Science Tokyo

picks.editorial_note: Tohoku University and Western Digital's joint lab tackles a critical but under-discussed bottleneck for AI scaling: next-generation data storage capable of keeping pace with AI's growing data demands.
picks.title: Tohoku University Launches AI Data Infrastructure Lab with Western Digital Corporation
